Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
You stagger back under a hail of axe strokes.
>Time passes...
The flat of the troll's axe skins across your forearm.
>Time passes...
The troll's axe removes your head.
It appears that that last blow was too much for you.  I'm afraid you
are dead.
Do you want me to try to patch you?Now, let me see...
Well, we weren't quite able to restore your state.  You can't have
everything.
>You are in a forest, with trees in all directions around you.
>You are empty handed.
>You have a light wound, which will be cured after 27 moves.
You can be killed by one more light wound.
You have been killed once.
>
Your score would be 25 [total of 500 points], in 23 moves.
This score gives you the rank of Amateur Adventurer.
>Beg pardon?
>

>Beg pardon?

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>Beg pardon?
>

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.

A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
>Beg pardon?

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
>Beg pardon?
>

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,

>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
>Time passes...
>Beg pardon?
>

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Beg pardon?
>

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Beg pardon?
>

>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,

>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have

 A quantity of water

There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions.

out of the room.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
>Time passes...
>Time passes...

>Beg pardon?

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
You stagger back under a hail of axe strokes.
>Time passes...
The flat of the troll's axe skins across your forearm.
>Beg pardon?
>

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
>Time passes...
You stagger back under a hail of axe strokes.
>Time passes...
The flat of the troll's axe skins across your forearm.
>Time passes...

It appears that that last blow was too much for you.  I'm afraid you
are dead.
Do you want me to try to patch you?Now, let me see...
Well, we weren't quite able to restore your state.  You can't have
everything.
>

 A quantity of water

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions.
